def: the fore-arm, i.e. (as a measure) a cubit

occurrences.text: Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit unto his stature?
And the other disciples came in a little ship; (for they were not far from land, but as it were two hundred cubits,) dragging the net with fishes.
And he measured the wall thereof, an hundred and forty and four cubits, according to the measure of a man, that is, of the angel.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
